snippet.title: Two Little Words That Make Friends 💛 Spread Salam! | Islam for Kids #shorts
snippet.description:
Do you know two little words that make people love each other? Our beloved Prophet Muhammad (Sallallahu Alaihi Wa Alihi Wasallam) taught us: "Spread salam among yourselves."

Say "Assalamu Alaikum" (peace be upon you), and answer "Wa Alaikum Assalam". At home, at school and at the masjid!

Who will your little one say salam to first today?

Source
• Sahih Muslim 54: https://sunnah.com/muslim:54

We never show any Prophet or Companion. All characters are faceless.
For ages 3 to 9 · Ahl-e-Sunnat wal Jama'at

#IslamForKids #MuslimKids #Salam #shorts
